[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- Six prompt-rewriting modes: **Default**, **Concise**, **Structured**, **Creative**, **Translate an"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"d optimize**, and **Code request**.
- Three language choices: **Follow draft**, **Chinese**, or **En"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"glish**. An explicit language choice is applied after optional custom preferences; in Translate and "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"optimize mode, **Follow draft** means optimize without translating.
- Optional context injection fro"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"m the current session: goal, todo list, compaction summary, recent messages, and—when both context s"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"witches are enabled—short tool-result summaries.
- A result popover with the original draft, optimiz"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ed draft, **Adopt optimized result**, **Keep draft**, and **Later** actions. Results are never autom"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"atically adopted.
- Stop while a model stream is running; when the DSH conversation-block API is ava"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ilable, clear the composer block immediately and ignore late results from the cancelled run.
- Failu"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"re results stay visible with the original draft and a **Retry** action.
- A current-component, in-me"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"mory history of the last five optimization attempts. Successful entries can be reviewed or explicitl"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"y refilled into the composer; failed entries are retained as failure records.
- Settings are saved l"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"ocally and best-effort synchronized to a workspace file.
- The browser UI uses DSH theme tokens and "},{"id":"p10s14","text":"supports light/dark themes, keyboard focus, Escape/outside-click dismissal, reduced motion, and high"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"-contrast borders. The composer controls stay quiet at rest: **Optimize** is transparent when idle a"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"nd gains a host interactive surface only on hover, focus, or press, with lighter label text matching"},{"id":"p10s17","text":" adjacent DSH controls."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Requirements and compatibility"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness with a compatible Web profile that provides the plugin's Host and browser depende"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ncies.
- **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0.** Version 0.4.1 keeps the DSH 0.2 Typert migration "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"and fixes the full settings modal surface; version 0.4.0 first migrated both Host and Client Typert "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"strict codecs to the DSH 0.2 `create()` factory contract. It no longer supports DSH 0.1.x; use plugi"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"n 0.3.2 there.
- The package targets `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4`, the DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` service pack"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ages listed in `package.json`, and React `^18.2.0`; it directly depends on `zod ^4.4.3`. The package"},{"id":"p12s7","text":" declares Node.js `>=20`.
- A configured DSH model provider is required for optimization. Provider a"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"vailability, model limits, network access, and provider policy remain outside this package."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Security, privacy, and known limitations"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Guardrail or boundary | What the code does | Important limitation |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Provider data flow | Uses DSH's configured LLM service and adds no separate plugin endpoint. | Dra"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"fts and enabled context can leave the machine through that provider. Provider retention, logging, an"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"d regional handling are outside this plugin. |
| Context opt-in | Goal, todo, messages, compaction, "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"and tool summaries are added only when the context switch is enabled; tool summaries additionally re"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"quire the tool-result switch. | Context collection is bounded and budget-pruned, so it may be incomp"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"lete. Do not treat a missing item as proof that it was absent from the session. |
| Untrusted refere"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"nce data | The Host prompt labels draft/context as reference data and instructs the model not to exe"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"cute instructions inside them. | This is instruction-based prompt-injection handling, not a determin"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"istic security boundary. Review model output. |
| Draft and custom limits | Drafts over 20,000 chara"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"cters are rejected; custom instructions are trimmed to 500 characters. | These are application limit"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"s, not protection against expensive or sensitive model requests. |
| Workspace writes | L3 writes go"},{"id":"p15s12","text":" through the DSH file service and sandbox policy. | A denied or unavailable write falls back to L1; "},{"id":"p15s13","text":"the workspace file is not an encrypted secret store. |
| Composer writes | Optimization results requ"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"ire explicit adoption and an unchanged draft. | **Refill** from history intentionally writes to the "},{"id":"p15s15","text":"composer; **Keep draft** and **Later** only dismiss the pending result. |
| Local history | Last-fiv"},{"id":"p15s16","text":"e attempts are kept in component memory only. | History is not durable and can include failed output"},{"id":"p15s17","text":"/error text until the component is destroyed. |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The plugin itself does not collect credentials or create a database. - Browser-to-Host calls use the Typert contribution declared in `lib/typert.host"},{"id":"p19s4","text":".js`; the plugin does not expose another HTTP API.
